app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Hold sideways. A: impulse / hold for 5 Hz motion, slow cruise and wider feedback slits. Shake: 2.5x impulse. B: region inversion. 1: palette. 2: ring / cross / spike / ribbon space. D-pad: directional impulse and feedback twist. Plus: 35 degree telephoto. Minus: 135 degree wide angle. Plus and Minus together: reset. HOME: exit. No sensor bar required.
